title: Stop Saying "Very Beautiful"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very beautiful". Try one of these instead:
• Gorgeous: gorgeous in that dress
• Stunning: a stunning view from the top
• Breathtaking: a breathtaking sunset over the sea
• Exquisite: an exquisite silver necklace
• Radiant: a radiant bride

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.

Find more words on anotherwordfor.net
